what_it_does: This paper addresses reliability in high-speed chip-to-chip interconnects (the communication links between processors, including CXL, NVIDIA's NVLink, and other standards) by adding sequence numbers to track data packets. It proposes the RXL protocol—an extension to the CXL standard—that detects when packets are silently lost and ensures data arrives in the correct order. Multiple error-checking layers work together to catch and correct transmission faults.
